node.statement: Let e_j be the unit of the j-th block, so ||e_j||=1. Since eta<=rho_Upsilon'<=rho_T, lem-routef-raw-factor-norms gives ||tilde-Delta(e_j)||>=1-C_V*eta; since eta<=rho_Upsilon'<=rho_Delta, lem-routef-delta-normalization-closeness gives ||Delta-tilde-Delta||_cb<=C_Delta*eta. Therefore ||Delta(e_j)||>=1-(C_V+C_Delta)*eta=1-C_N*eta.
